evidence: 183 recorded snapshots match within 1e-6 over a 5,433-step run.
limits: Outbound run only: the return leg, the phase after a fall and the later phases of the original are not ported.
Meshy-generated runner and props over custom toon-shaded road and sky; an independent reconstruction of the mechanics, not a pixel-parity or 1:1 port.
Has a title with runner select, countdown, pause, results, best score and synthesised sound effects.
Verified in remote software WebGL2 (SwiftShader), not on a hardware GPU.

checks.name: mounts examples port without code duplication
